dataset: MIT-BIH VFDB (PhysioNet), 22 recordings, 5s windows; 6285 train / 1257 val / 1676 test segments
evaluation: held-out TEST set only (no train-set eval, no random weights)
class_note: Non-targeted rhythms (AFIB, SBR, etc.) grouped into the Normal/background class; the binary head is the safety-relevant output.
